name: saref
label: SAREF (Smart Appliances)
description: EU Smart Appliances Reference ontology — smart home IoT standard required by EU IoT regulations
short_description: EU Smart Appliances Reference ontology — smart home IoT standard required by EU IoT regulations
long_description: SAREF (Smart Appliances REFerence ontology) ETSI TS 103 264 enables smart home device interoperability across EU manufacturers and IoT platforms.
when_to_use: Use for smart building management, home energy management, or EU IoT compliance. Referenced in EU energy product regulations and required for some Horizon Europe IoT project grants.

table_notes.saref_device: Registry of all smart appliances and IoT devices with manufacturer metadata, EU energy class rating, and current activation status.
table_notes.saref_building_space: Hierarchical spatial model of building locations (rooms, floors, zones) used to associate devices with physical places.
table_notes.saref_property_measurement: High-volume time-series table storing sensor readings from devices; partition by timestamp for large deployments.
table_notes.saref_command: Audit log of all control commands issued to devices, capturing intent, parameters, and execution outcome.

saref_device.name: id
saref_device.description: Unique device identifier (stable across firmware updates)

saref_device.name: manufacturer
saref_device.description: Brand or company that manufactured the device

saref_device.name: model
saref_device.description: Manufacturer model number or product name

saref_device.name: serial_number
saref_device.description: Hardware serial number as printed on the device label

saref_device.name: device_category
saref_device.description: SAREF device category (e.g. Sensor, Actuator, Meter, HVAC)

saref_device.name: functions
saref_device.description: SAREF function list; array of {functionType, command} objects per ontology spec

saref_device.name: states
saref_device.description: Current device state snapshot; keys map to SAREF State class instances (e.g. OnOffState)

saref_device.name: energy_class
saref_device.description: EU energy efficiency label (A+++, A++, A+, A–G) per EU 2021/341 regulation

saref_device.name: location_id
saref_device.description: Building space where this device is installed; references saref_building_space.id

saref_device.name: is_active
saref_device.description: False when device is decommissioned or offline; used to filter active inventory

saref_device.name: commissioned_at
saref_device.description: Date the device was first installed and put into service

saref_building_space.name: name
saref_building_space.description: Human-readable label for the space (e.g. 'Living Room', 'Floor 2 East Wing')

saref_building_space.name: space_type
saref_building_space.description: Classification of the space (e.g. Room, Floor, Zone, Building) per SAREF4BLDG

saref_building_space.name: floor_area_m2
saref_building_space.description: Floor area of the space in square metres

saref_building_space.name: parent_id
saref_building_space.description: Parent space in the containment hierarchy; references saref_building_space.id (self-join)

saref_building_space.name: geometry
saref_building_space.description: PostGIS polygon footprint of the space in WGS84; enables spatial overlap and area queries

saref_property_measurement.name: id
saref_property_measurement.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for each measurement row

saref_property_measurement.name: device_id
saref_property_measurement.description: Device that produced this measurement; references saref_device.id

saref_property_measurement.name: property_type
saref_property_measurement.description: SAREF property class being measured (e.g. Temperature, Humidity, Power, Illuminance)

saref_property_measurement.name: unit_of_measure
saref_property_measurement.description: UCUM or SAREF unit code for the measured value (e.g. CEL, W, lx, %RH)

saref_property_measurement.name: value
saref_property_measurement.description: Numeric sensor reading in the specified unit_of_measure

saref_property_measurement.name: timestamp
saref_property_measurement.description: UTC timestamp of when the measurement was taken by the device

saref_property_measurement.name: quality
saref_property_measurement.description: Data quality indicator: Good, Uncertain, Bad, or OutOfRange (per IEC 62541 OPC-UA)

saref_command.name: device_id
saref_command.description: Target device receiving this command; references saref_device.id

saref_command.name: command_type
saref_command.description: SAREF command class name (e.g. OnCommand, OffCommand, SetLevelCommand, ToggleCommand)

saref_command.name: parameters
saref_command.description: Command-specific arguments; structure varies by command_type (e.g. {level: 75} for dimmer)

saref_command.name: issued_at
saref_command.description: UTC timestamp when the command was created and enqueued

saref_command.name: executed_at
saref_command.description: UTC timestamp when the device acknowledged execution; NULL if still pending

saref_command.name: status
saref_command.description: Command lifecycle state: Pending, Sent, Executed, Failed, Cancelled

saref_command.name: issued_by
saref_command.description: Identity that issued the command (user ID, automation rule name, or system process)
